common.asks_question: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask the other party a question that needs an answer before the work can continue?

question_kind.instructions: What kind of question, if any, does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask?

criteria.clarification: asks what an earlier request means or how to satisfy it
criteria.technical: asks how to do something in R/Bioconductor, or about an error
criteria.process: asks about the submission or review process, policy, timing or next steps
criteria.scope: asks whether the package or a feature is appropriate for Bioconductor

common.hands_off: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE hand the next move to the other party, e.g. a submitter saying the changes are done and asking for another look, or a reviewer delivering feedback for the submitter to act on?
common.blocked: Does the author of the COMMENT TO EVALUATE say they cannot proceed: stuck, waiting on something outside their control, or unable to understand an error or request?
common.pushback: Does the author of the COMMENT TO EVALUATE disagree with or argue against a request or decision?

tone.instructions: What is the tone of the COMMENT TO EVALUATE?

common.about_build: Is the COMMENT TO EVALUATE mainly about automated build or check output (R CMD check, BiocCheck, build reports, bot messages) rather than the package's design or content?

review_kind.instructions: What kind of comment is the COMMENT TO EVALUATE, from the reviewer or Bioconductor team?

criteria.full_review: a substantive review of the package, requesting changes or approving it
criteria.partial_review: some review points, explicitly promising more later
criteria.follow_up: responds to the submitter's changes or replies on earlier points
criteria.nudge: reminds or chases the submitter for a response
criteria.administrative: a process note: assignment, labels, policy, triggering builds

n_requests.instructions: How many distinct changes does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask the submitter to make?

reviewer.req_checks: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask the submitter to fix R CMD check or BiocCheck errors, warnings or notes?
reviewer.req_vignette: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask for changes to the vignette?
reviewer.req_tests: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask for unit tests to be added or improved?
reviewer.req_docs: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask for changes to man pages, examples or the README?
reviewer.req_interop: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask the submitter to use or support Bioconductor classes such as SummarizedExperiment, GRanges or SingleCellExperiment?
reviewer.req_code_style: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask for changes to coding style or practices (e.g. vapply instead of sapply, seq_along, avoiding T/F)?
reviewer.req_data: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE raise data size, data provenance, or moving data to ExperimentHub/AnnotationHub?
reviewer.req_metadata: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask for changes to DESCRIPTION fields, version, biocViews, license or authors?
reviewer.req_scope: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE question whether the package or parts of it belong in Bioconductor?

request_clarity.instructions: How concrete are the change requests in the COMMENT TO EVALUATE?

effort_implied.instructions: How much work do the requests in the COMMENT TO EVALUATE imply for the submitter?

reviewer.new_requests: Compared with THIS AUTHOR'S PREVIOUS COMMENT, does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE raise change requests that were not asked for before?

decision_signal.instructions: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE signal a decision on the package?

criteria.lean_decline: doubts the package will be accepted

submitter.claims_all_addressed: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE say that all requested changes have been made?
submitter.claims_partial: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE say that only some requested changes have been made so far?
submitter.explains_not_doing: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE explain why a requested change will not be made?
submitter.asks_for_help: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE ask for help or guidance rather than just a review?
submitter.delay_notice: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE apologise for a delay or say the author is busy and will respond later?
submitter.newcomer: Does the COMMENT TO EVALUATE suggest the author is unfamiliar with Bioconductor or R package conventions?
